claims.claim: Fleurty Girl has French Quarter, Lakeside Metairie and Gretna doors that can host the Twelfth Night drop in January 2027.

sources.title: A rendering of Fleurty Girl's new flagship store planned to open in 2027. Rendering: Courtesy of Fleurty Girl

claims.evidence: Axios says the owner plans a new Metairie flagship in a former Double M Feed store for 2027 and will keep the nearby Lakeside location open through 2026. Results mention a Gretna store, but none confirms a current French Quarter door or says whether Lakeside stays open in January 2027.
claims.action: No change. Confirm every Fleurty Girl door, and whether Lakeside is still open in January 2027, before naming them as launch doors.

claims.claim: Dirty Coast runs a shop on Magazine Street that can serve as a launch door for Twelfth Night, Ward Call and Boil Season.
claims.evidence: Dirty Coast's own shop page lists an Uptown flagship at 5415 Magazine Street and a Lower Garden District shop at 1320 Magazine Street, plus a French Quarter shop on Chartres Street.

claims.claim: Dong Phuong Bakery in New Orleans East is operating and sells king cake, so it can supply a Carnival-night giveaway.

sources.title: Where to get King Cakes in the New Orleans area for Mardi Gras 2026

claims.evidence: Coverage of the 2026 Carnival season says Dong Phuong's online king cake orders were fully booked. Walk-in buyers could still get cakes at the 14207 Chef Menteur Highway storefront from 8 a.m. every day except Tuesday, limited to three per person.
claims.action: No change needed. Supply is tight, so lock the giveaway order early.

claims.claim: The Pelicans Team Store operates at Smoothie King Center as the launch door for Ward Call, Twelfth Night and school nights.
claims.evidence: The arena's Pelicans page says the official team store is inside Smoothie King Center, entered from Dave Dixon Drive. It opens weekdays 11 a.m. to 5 p.m., and on game days opens only to ticketed fans one hour before tip-off. Online sales run through pelicansteamstore.com.

claims.claim: The Pelicans' own 2026-27 opener date is still to confirm.
claims.evidence: The team's schedule announcement says the Pelicans open the regular season at Smoothie King Center against the Indiana Pacers on Wednesday, Oct 21. It also lists 39 home games.
claims.action: Named the Oct 21 home opener against Indiana in the strategy calendar window, hoops and rhythm moments and the verify lists. Updated two factcheck verdicts.

corrections.claim: The Pelicans' own opener date is still to confirm (strategy calendar, hoops and rhythm dossiers).
corrections.correction: The Pelicans open at home against Indiana on Wednesday, Oct 21, 2026, at Smoothie King Center.
